subject.title: feat: add publisher feed model API

question: Should ClawHub expose these unsigned publisher detail and feed endpoints as a permanent v1 public contract before the related hosted-feed RFC is finalized?
rationale: The patch is a broad new external API and stored projection model; code review can assess mechanics, but maintainers must choose the durable compatibility and distribution boundary.

options.title: Hold for contract acceptance
options.body: Keep the PR open until the publisher-only pagination contract and unsigned-discovery boundary are explicitly accepted alongside the RFC, then require live route proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the v1 API now
options.body: Approve this exact publisher-only contract as the stable v1 surface and review the branch with compatibility documentation and live proof as the remaining merge gates.

recommendation.title: Hold for contract acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the publisher-only pagination contract and unsigned-discovery boundary are explicitly accepted alongside the RFC, then require live route proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their collaborator review is the strongest supplied evidence of ownership of the publisher visibility and feed-contract invariants.
